readerCopy.body: One practical experiment can give shape to something that has existed mainly as an idea, longing, or intuition. When Neptune sextiles the North Node, imagination and forward movement cooperate, making a creative or compassionate goal specific enough to evaluate once it has a form outside the mind. A prototype, meeting, application, budget, or first deliverable can reveal what the idea can actually carry. Certainty is not required before beginning; enough structure to learn something is.
